id: \rAre you prepared for how amazing this will be?
en: \rAre you prepared for how amazing this will be?
it: \rSei pronto a vedere quanto sarà fantastico?

id: \rHm. I suppose I can give you a battle.
en: \rHm. I suppose I can give you a battle.
it: \rUhm. Suppongo di poterti concedere una lotta.

id: \bAlain: I see you got rid of that group that called themselves Team Rocket. You did it so quickly I wasn't even able to get here in time.
en: \bAlain: I see you got rid of that group that called themselves Team Rocket. You did it so quickly I wasn't even able to get here in time.
it: \bAlain: Vedo che ti sei sbarazzato di quel gruppo che si faceva chiamare Team Rocket. L'hai fatto così in fretta che non sono nemmeno riuscito ad arrivare in tempo.

id: \bBut now I have enough time for another battle. Let's begin.
en: \bBut now I have enough time for another battle. Let's begin.
it: \bMa ora ho abbastanza tempo per un'altra lotta. Cominciamo.

id: \bYou're strong enough. Take this with you.
en: \bYou're strong enough. Take this with you.
it: \bSei abbastanza forte. Porta questo con te.

id: \bUnlock your full power with that. Until next time.
en: \bUnlock your full power with that. Until next time.
it: \bLibera tutto il tuo potere con questo. Alla prossima.

id: \bDon't break someone's locks. It's rude. My former apprentice learned that the hard way.
en: \bDon't break someone's locks. It's rude. My former apprentice learned that the hard way.
it: \bNon rompere le serrature altrui. È maleducazione. Il mio ex apprendista l'ha imparato a sue spese.

id: \rNurse Joy: You seem tired. Take a break.
en: \rNurse Joy: You seem tired. Take a break.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Sembri stanco. Fai una pausa.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now! The Pokémon here can be a little wild.
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now! The Pokémon here can be a little wild.
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto.  Abbi cura di te! I Pokémon qui possono essere un po' selvaggi.

id: \rI need to stop making impulse decisions.
en: \rI need to stop making impulse decisions.
